summary: Rockstar's western action series, from Red Dead Revolver through the Redemption games and standalone Red Dead Online.

entries.title: Red Dead Revolver

primary.why: Revolver began on PS2 and Xbox, then received later PlayStation and modern releases; PS5 is selected as the current high-fidelity console route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current PlayStation release on PS5, or use the original PS2/Xbox releases for first-version preservation.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use original PS2/Xbox for historical preservation if needed.

entries.title: Red Dead Redemption
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows release with Undead Nightmare

primary.version: Current PC release with Undead Nightmare
primary.why: Red Dead Redemption now has a Windows release including Undead Nightmare, making PC the highest-fidelity and most complete story-content route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release with Undead Nightmare installed; document graphics settings and patch version.

entries.remaster_caveats: Document whether multiplayer/history is in scope; modern releases focus on single-player plus Undead Nightmare.

entries.title: Red Dead Redemption 2

primary.why: Red Dead Redemption 2 shipped on PS4 and Xbox One before PC and Stadia; Windows is the highest-fidelity route with the broadest graphics/settings path.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows release through Rockstar, Steam, Epic, or another PC storefront; document graphics settings and patch version.

entries.remaster_caveats: Document patch and settings; Stadia is historical only.

entries.title: Red Dead Online

primary.why: Red Dead Online became a standalone release on PC and consoles; Windows is the best capture/settings route for the current online client.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows standalone/client; document patch, account, role progression, and server state.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service state and account progression matter.
